description: Given a situation, picks 6 fitting classic templates, writes captions for them with a language model and returns the 6 finished memes (text drawn on the stock template images, no AI image generation). Each meme is also saved to the user's My Memes. Requires the user's Memegician account; counts as one AI meme generation in their plan's allowance (unlimited on paid plans, fair use).

situation.description: What the memes should be about, e.g. "my code works on the first try"

name: generate_memes
title: Generate memes with AI
